sources.title: GitHub - mx4ai/qwen2.5: Qwen2.5 is the large language model series ...
sources.snippet: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. Dense, easy-to-use, decoder-only language models, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B sizes, and base and instruct variants. Pretrained on our latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18T tokens.

sources.title: Qwen 2.5 — Local Setup, VRAM, and Use Cases (2026) | local-llm.net
sources.snippet: What is Qwen 2.5? Qwen 2.5 is Alibaba's open-weights language model. Released in 2024-09, it ships in 7 sizes (0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, 72B) and is licensed Apache 2.0 (most sizes). The most popular use case is strongest 7B-32B on consumer hardware. VRAM and hardware The smallest 0.5B size needs at least 1 GB VRAM; the largest 72B needs around 5 GB.
